description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buy deep-link on the selected marketplace. amazon.se links carry ?tag=sw-dormkit-21; amazon.com links carry ?tag=sw-dormkit-20. Missing store falls back (en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se).

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for the shopper (e.g. en-US, sv-SE). Recommended; en-US without a marketplace selects amazon.com.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront id (us, se) or domain (amazon.com, amazon.se). Recommended. For US shoppers pass marketplace=amazon.com (US catalog, amazon.com /dp/ links, tag sw-dormkit-20). If omitted: locale en-US selects amazon.com, anything else falls back to amazon.se (never an error).

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve product buy link
